Answer the question: during 2-3 h, is the osmotic pressure of the substance A solution less than or greater than the osmotic pressure of the cell sap?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Put the mature cells of a certain plant into a substance A solution of a certain concentration, and it is found that the change trend of the volume of its protoplast (that is, the part inside the cell wall in a plant cell) is as shown in the figure. Answer the question: during 2-3 h, is the osmotic pressure of the substance A solution less than or greater than the osmotic pressure of the cell sap?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the horizontal axis is time/h, and the vertical axis is relative volume of the protoplast/%; the curve begins to decrease from about 100% at 0 h, drops to the lowest at about around 1.5 h, and then gradually rises. During the time period of 2-3 h, the curve shows an upward trend, indicating that the relative volume of the protoplast continuously increases. Then reason: an increase in the volume of the protoplast of a mature plant cell indicates that the cell is absorbing water; when the cell absorbs water, the osmotic pressure of the external solution is lower than the osmotic pressure of the cell sap. Therefore, during 2-3 h, the osmotic pressure of the substance A solution is less than the osmotic pressure of the cell sap.
